about: SYNTHETIC DATA. Reporting details of Rheinbank AG, a fictional bank, for the draft initial notification (ITS-R Annex II, fields 1.2 to 1.15). Not a real company. The LEI is fake: its check digits are 00, which fails the ISO 17442 check, so it can never match a real LEI. Phone numbers start with 0 after +49, which no German number does. Email addresses use the reserved .example domain (RFC 2606). No real person is named.
